titulo_es.@es: contrastar la pasiva impersonal y la personal
titulo_es.@en: to test the passive impersonal and the personal

texto.@es: **It is reported that + oración conjugada**: **It is reported that the footbridge will close next Monday**. Aquí **it** no se refiere a un objeto concreto; no se identifica quién comunica la información.
texto.@en: **It is reported that + oración conjugada**: **It is reported that the footbridge will close next Monday**. **it** here does not refer to a specific object; it does not identify who communicates the information.

texto.@es: **Sujeto + is/are reported + to + infinitivo**: **The footbridge is reported to be unsafe**. La pasarela pasa a ser el tema. Ambas formas pueden expresar el mismo informe: **It is reported that the footbridge is unsafe**. La construcción atribuye información, no la confirma.
texto.@en: **Sujeto + is/are reported + to + infinitivo**: **The footbridge is reported to be unsafe**. The catwalk becomes the subject. Both forms can express the same report: **It is reported that the footbridge is unsafe**. The construction attributes information, does not confirm it.

frases.en: It is reported that the footbridge will close next Monday.
frases.es: Se informa de que la pasarela peatonal cerrará el próximo lunes.

frases.en: The footbridge is reported to be unsafe.
frases.es: Se informa de que la pasarela no es segura.

frases.en: Visitors should use the main bridge until repairs are finished.
frases.es: Los visitantes deberían usar el puente principal hasta que terminen las reparaciones.

explicacion.@es: La primera frase indica el día.
explicacion.@en: The first sentence indicates the day.

explicacion.@es: El texto no menciona el viernes.
explicacion.@en: The text does not mention Friday.

explicacion.@es: El aviso dice que cerrará la semana próxima.
explicacion.@en: The ad says it'll close next week.

bloques.frase: It is reported ___ the footbridge will close next Monday.

explicacion.@es: **To be** pertenece a la construcción con el tema como sujeto.
explicacion.@en: **To be** belongs to the construction with the theme as subject.

explicacion.@es: Esta forma no introduce la oración que sigue.
explicacion.@en: This form does not introduce the following prayer.

pregunta.@es: What does **it** refer to in “It is reported that the footbridge will close next Monday”?
pregunta.@en: What does **it** refer to in - It is reported that the football bridge will close next Monday?

opciones.texto: It is a dummy subject; it does not refer to a specific thing.

explicacion.@es: En esta construcción, **it** no sustituye al tema del informe.
explicacion.@en: In this construction, **it** does not replace the subject of the report.

explicacion.@es: No se identifica quién comunica la información.

pregunta.@es: Which sentence expresses the same report as “It is reported that the footbridge is unsafe”?
pregunta.@en: When sentence expresses the same report as "It is reported that the football bridge is unsafe"?

opciones.texto: The footbridge is reported to be unsafe.

explicacion.@es: Cambia la estructura, no el contenido del informe.
explicacion.@en: It changes the structure, not the content of the report.

opciones.texto: The footbridge reports that it is unsafe.

explicacion.@es: Presenta a la pasarela como quien informa.
explicacion.@en: He presents the walkway as the one who reports.

opciones.texto: It is reported that the footbridge to be unsafe.

explicacion.@es: Después de **that** hace falta una oración con verbo conjugado.
explicacion.@en: After **that**, a conjugated verb prayer is needed.

explicacion.@es: El aviso la declara no segura y dice que cerrará.
explicacion.@en: The notice declares it unsure and says it will close.

explicacion.@es: El texto no menciona un museo.
explicacion.@en: The text does not mention a museum.

bloques.frase: The footbridge is reported to be unsafe.

opciones.texto: Se informa de que la pasarela no es segura.

explicacion.@es: La forma con sujeto + infinitivo expresa el informe sobre la pasarela.
explicacion.@en: The form with subject + infinitive expresses the report on the catwalk.

opciones.texto: La pasarela informa de que algo no es seguro.

explicacion.@es: La pasarela es el tema, no quien informa.
explicacion.@en: The catwalk is the subject, not the one who reports.

opciones.texto: Se confirmó que la pasarela es peligrosa.

explicacion.@es: **Is reported** no confirma la veracidad del informe.
explicacion.@en: **Is reported** does not confirm the veracity of the report.

bloques.frase: The footbridge is reported to be unsafe

traduccion.@es: Se informa de que la pasarela no es segura
traduccion.@en: It is reported that the catwalk is not safe

intro.@es: Lee un aviso ficticio y practica cómo cambia la construcción cuando destacas el informe o el tema del que se informa.
intro.@en: Read a fictional notice and practice how construction changes when you highlight the report or the subject that is reported.
